fields.label: Project reference
fields.description: Exact authoritative project identity whose Question, work item, and Decision will be reconciled.

fields.label: Question reference
fields.description: Exact existing unprocessed Question feed-entry identity that this decision resolves.

fields.label: Work-item action
fields.description: Private exact action text of the current unchecked project work item completed by this decision.

fields.label: Decision headline
fields.description: Private exact Update Feed headline; Automation does not invent or paraphrase it.

fields.label: What was decided
fields.description: Private exact decision statement used as the first part of the governed Decision summary.

fields.label: Decided by
fields.description: Private exact attribution supplied by the operator; no person identity is inferred.

fields.label: Why
fields.description: Optional private rationale. If omitted, the prepared Decision shows the governed explicit missing-why marker instead of inventing a reason.

fields.label: Decision date
fields.description: Private exact calendar date for the Decision feed entry.

fields.label: Visibility
fields.description: Portable audience classification allowed by the shared Projects policy.
